args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the v2.3.1 regression. Prior state: v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 had never previously been deployed to production, so the rollout required and received change-manager approval. Deploy status: rolled_out and verified. Tracking incident opened to record the change and monitor post-deploy health.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 shipped to all production regions

trace.final:

1. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2** — Since v2.3.2 had never been released to production before, the deploy required change-manager approval under the org policy; approval was granted ("Approved. Looks right") and the rollout completed across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Post-deploy verification:** checkout-api is now **healthy** across all three regions with the error rate down to **0.2%** (from 18%).
